niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean but information-rich interfaces: light or airy themes, strong vertical balance, clearly separated sections, and layouts that feel complete rather than sparse. They like concise, direct copy, explicit labels, and obvious controls. They generally favor screens that show more useful content at once, with a finished, intentional feel, while avoiding clutter, rough drafts, or overly dense text-heavy presentations.

criteria.description: Prefers screens that show more useful settings, rows, or actions at once instead of sparse layouts with lots of empty space.
Prefers sections that feel fully populated, finished, and intentional rather than partial, unfinished, or placeholder-like.
Prefers layouts that distribute content evenly down the page and avoid large unused lower areas or top-heavy compositions.
Prefers descriptive, specific labels and concise copy that make options and states immediately understandable.
Prefers straightforward full-width list rows and linear settings flows over card-heavy, grouped-block, or fragmented structures.
Prefers obvious chevrons, toggles, buttons, and progression controls that make actions and navigation easy to spot.
Prefers light, airy, soft, and open visual styling over dark, heavy, or overly saturated presentation.
Prefers clear section headers, separators, and grouped categories that make the page structure easy to scan.
Prefers interfaces that keep secondary visuals, extra banners, and competing elements out of the way so the main task stays focused.
